g.text: 1. DUAL REDUNDANT PSU SYSTEM WITH OR-ING CONTROLLER FOR HIGH AVAILABILITY
2. SBC HANDLES WEB INTERFACE AND HIGH-LEVEL MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS
